name: android_get_device_stats
description: Reads one kind of device data: device (model, Android version, screen, battery %), battery (level, temperature, health, charger), network (IP, Wi-Fi SSID, link speed), cpu (top processes or one package), memory (PSS and heaps of a package), gfx (frame and jank stats of a View/Compose app), fps (real frame rate of any window, games included: samples durationMs, or with 0 reads recent frames), thermal (throttling status and temperatures).

package.description: Required for memory and gfx; optional for cpu and fps (default: the foreground app).

durationMs.description: fps: how long to sample (default 2000); 0 reads the frames already drawn, e.g. right after a swipe.

deviceSerial.description: Device serial or IP:port from android_list_devices. Required when several devices are connected; may be omitted when only one is.
